title: Sync any runners-config schema copy ticks still carries
description:
tick tda says to keep the schema 'in references/runners-config.schema.json in sync (ticks repo)', but ticfac's own references test states ticks dropped its runner references at v0.32.0 and internal/runconfig/runners-config.schema.json is the only place the schema lives. This tick updated THAT copy (configs, and tier_policy, which the schema had never named). If ticks still ships a copy anywhere (a skill, a doc, a vendored reference), it is now stale by two tables and should be synced or deleted.
evidence: internal/runconfig/references_test.go:20 ('every runner reference ticks' skill dropped at v0.32.0 is a file in this package ... ticfac is the only place it can live'); .tick/issues/tda.json's description names the ticks repo

Filed by ticfac run epic-v5t of pengelbrecht/ticfac from the finding f0eae07880f078e0376bf41e8b03dab9c8c9c79d4d1a04883ffddf0a5619d125 (upstream-tick, severity low), reported by run-epic-v5t/tick-tda/attempt-2. The finding was routed to this repository; the run that found it cannot fix another repository, so it filed it here rather than hold its own epic on it.
